name: Eugene V. Debs
role: American labor leader and Socialist Party presidential candidate (1855-1926)
summary: Debs was a railway union leader who became the leading American socialist of his era, running for president five times. He argued for social ownership of industry, industrial unionism, a party of working people independent of the capitalist parties, equal rights regardless of race and sex, and opposition to militarism and World War I, for which he was imprisoned under the Sedition Act.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Declared that private ownership and competition had had their day, and set social ownership and cooperation against them.

public-ownership.rationale: Said the nation ought to own and control its industries and called for the railroads, telegraph, mines and mills to be taken over in the people's name.

unions-good.rationale: Spent his career organizing railway and industrial unions and described unions as the economic arm of the labour movement.

property-fundamental.rationale: Held that industry should be the common property of all, and wanted idle land and mines taken from private owners.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Mocked regulation of the trusts as inadequate and wanted them owned socially instead, so he did not back tighter regulation as the remedy.

worker-ownership.rationale: Told workers they must own their own tools and organize to manage industry themselves, and demanded complete control of industry by the workers.

strong-leader.rationale: Said he never had much faith in leaders, preferred the rank and file, and held that the Socialist Party should have no boss.

state-harmful.rationale: Criticised anarchists for abandoning the ballot and proposed to win control of government and use it to transfer industry to the workers.

empower-police-military.rationale: Argued for cutting the army back to its small peacetime footing and described police, militia and army as tools of the ruling class against strikers.

rehabilitation.rationale: Wrote that prison was moving from punishment toward reformation of the offender and said it is better to stop breeding crime than to punish criminals.

more-religion-public.rationale: Condemned clergy who served wealth and opposed religious compulsion, though he used Christian language and honoured Jesus.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Said the white race could never atone for the treatment of Black Americans and condemned lynching, but located the remedy in class solidarity and economic freedom rather than race-specific measures.

gradual-change.rationale: Called for a change of system, not reform, and wanted the Socialist Party to stay uncompromisingly revolutionary.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Denounced a Socialist congress committee's majority report that would exclude Asian immigrants, and in 1891 rejected the outcry against pauper immigration.

free-trade.rationale: Said that tariff and free trade policies leave workers in poverty alike, citing free-trade England and protected America, so he did not credit free trade with benefiting all.

nation-first.rationale: Held that the workers of all countries are friends and the capitalists of all countries enemies, and looked toward a universal commonwealth.

open-borders.rationale: Wrote that immigrant workers had as good a right to enter as anyone and that socialism must not shut the international door.

revolution-justified.rationale: Hailed the revolutions of the past, said the Russian monarchy would be swept away, and in 1919 declared himself a Bolshevik.

experts-over-public.rationale: Distrusted leaders and intellectuals, mocked the claim that rule takes brains workers lack, and wanted the working class to rule.

central-planning.rationale: Pointed out that government-run railroads ran well after the high-paid 'brains' were fired and demanded national takeover of industries.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Wanted the means of production held in common by the people rather than spread among small owners.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Demanded the overthrow of the wage system; he did not speak of abolishing money.

one-party-rule.rationale: Admired the Bolsheviks' uncompromising rule, yet in 1922 said the Russian way need not be the American way and claimed equal right to conviction for others.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Denounced kaisers, czars and Junkers as autocrats and predicted that revolt would sweep the Russian monarchy out of existence.

democracy-best.rationale: Called the Socialist Party the only truly democratic party and pressed for industrial and political democracy while still urging workers to use the ballot.

workers-councils.rationale: Called the industrial union the forerunner of industrial democracy and backed the Soviet government, but ran for office and urged workers to conquer political power through the party.

natural-rulers.rationale: Rejected the capitalist claim that it takes brains to rule and said the working class would rule.

political-violence-never.rationale: Said Socialists did not advocate violence yet praised John Brown's blow against slavery and revolutions including the Russian one.

war-builds-character.rationale: Wrote that war is murder in uniform and called it unspeakable barbarism waged for the profit of rulers.

separate-church-state.rationale: Objected to using law to enforce Sunday closing and puritan morals, though he said church-going was people's own affair.

military-superiority.rationale: Argued that a large standing army weakens the nation and the army should be cut back to its small peacetime footing.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Insisted that the party and the working class know no race and opposed excluding immigrant races.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Treated the class struggle as the shaping force of society and described wars and rule through the master-class versus subject-class lens.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Said the brute struggle for existence appealed to the basest in man and set cooperation and social service against it.

restore-past-order.rationale: Looked forward to a new social order and new world, not to restoring any former one.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Insisted on keeping party policy uncompromisingly in line with principle rather than judging by votes gained.

direct-action.rationale: Argued that organizing industrially while uniting politically in the Socialist Party was the real direct action and called Mexican anarchist direct action fruitless.

production-for-use.rationale: Described the coming order as producing wealth for the use of all instead of the private profit of the few.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Described the owner who 'might as well own the miners' as taking profit from the unpaid labour of the working class.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Inferred: backed the Bolshevik regime and its working-class rule in 1919 and 1922 but never described a dictatorship of the proletariat in his own terms.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Wrote that wars have been fought for conquest and plunder, and that peace waits on the end of profit and plunder among nations.

harm-principle.rationale: Defended people's right to spend Sundays and amusements as they chose so long as they did not interfere with their neighbours' equal rights.

positive-liberty.rationale: Said men cannot be free while they live by the masters' sufferance and that economic freedom is the real issue behind social inequality.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Treated white superiority as a myth held by ignorant whites and said the Black race's progress came from its own effort.

total-state.rationale: Called the Espionage Act a despotic enactment in conflict with free institutions and defended free speech and press.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Described the scramble of nations for supremacy and 'spoil and plunder of conquest' as capitalist wars, and mocked 'civilizing' conquest in the Philippines.

bound-labor.rationale: Denounced feudal lords and their serfs and wage slavery as forms of bondage.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Said industry should be democratically administered in the interest of all and called for industrial democracy with workers managing industry.

national-self-determination.rationale: Wanted the people of each disputed province to decide their own nation and praised Socialists who protested the annexation of Alsace-Lorraine.

class-collaboration.rationale: Held that the interests of those who make wealth and those who take it are not identical, attacked the Civic Federation and told workers capitalists were their enemies.

workers-nation.rationale: Said the Socialist Party expresses the interests of the toilers of all the world and that the class war is the workers' only war.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Supported absolute equality between the sexes and noted the party denies membership to a man who refuses to see woman as his political equal.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Condemned Jim Crow cars and disfranchisement as part of the shameful exploitation of Black Americans.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Described the courts, police and army as serving the ruling class and said workers must wrest government from capitalist control.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Wrote that subjection of women is embedded in the laws and economic system, including denial of property rights and the vote.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Called the Republican and Democratic parties corrupt servants of Wall Street and politicians bought and paid for by the ruling class.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Demanded that the nation own and democratically run its industries rather than limit government to defence and justice.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Said he was not one bit better than the meanest on earth and that all workers are comrades regardless of nationality, race, creed, colour or sex.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Described the goal as a free nation whose government is of and by and for the people and said the people should decide on war.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Said the cunning few triumphed in the brute struggle for existence and looked to a society where competition is only to excel in good work and service.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Protested the suppression of Socialist papers and the imprisonment of Socialists as disloyalists for their opposition to the war.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Argued workers who live by the masters' sufferance are industrial slaves who cannot be free until they own their tools and control their jobs.

vanguard-party.rationale: Distrusted leaders and intellectuals, wanted a party run from the bottom up with no boss, and relied on the rank and file's education.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Said while there is a lower class he is in it and urged that the party discriminate, if at all, in favour of the most oppressed.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Led the Pullman strike, was jailed after injunctions were used against it and opposed injunctions against labour as judicial usurpation.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Said poverty is not the fault of nature or the Almighty but is due entirely to the outgrown social system.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Argued the working class must unite across race and nationality and refused to divide it by race prejudice.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Called the Espionage Act a despotic enactment and protested that wartime conditions made constitutional free speech dangerous.

party-controls-media.rationale: Protested that Socialist papers were suppressed and defended the working-class press.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: After opposing the 1912 anti-sabotage amendment, said that once adopted it should be obeyed.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Said Socialists were neither pro-German nor pro-Ally and refused to fight capitalist wars, but never called for working people to seek their own government's defeat.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Denounced the obscenity prosecution of Moses Harman as heartless hypocrisy and offered to share his prison cell.

people-in-arms.rationale: Preferred a volunteer citizen-soldiery to a standing army and said the people could be relied on to defend the country.

death-penalty.rationale: Wrote that he was set like steel against capital punishment.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Condemned the mean and narrow fanaticism of enforced Sunday closing and the tame submission of people to intolerance.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Described the Bolshevik revolution as a working-class rise to power and urged support for the Soviet government.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Praised Liebknecht and Bebel for protesting the annexation of Alsace-Lorraine, though he did not call it an occupation.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Showed contempt for kaisers, czars and emperors as autocrats to whom plutocrats grovelled.

character-from-environment.rationale: Held that vice and crime flow from social conditions and said he was no better than the meanest on earth.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Reproached presidents and governors for violating the constitution and reminded Roosevelt of his oath to support it.

leader-cult.rationale: Said he would be ashamed to have risen from the ranks rather than with them and was suspicious of leaders.

land-redistribution.rationale: Said idle land held by landlords should be put to use and demanded the earth for all the people, and noted the Mexican cry of land and liberty without disowning it.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Described Marx's materialistic conception of history as the fundamental law of social development and scientific basis of socialism.

ban-cartels.rationale: Said the old parties wanted to regulate the trusts while Socialists wanted to own them and that competition had had its day.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Complained that a 5-4 Supreme Court of corporation lawyers struck down the child labour law that the public had won, and that no working class person has named a federal judge.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Warned that direct action by small armed groups would lead to Haymarket sacrifices and the useless shedding of blood.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Attacked titles of broken-down aristocrats and Junker privilege as parasitic.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Mocked US soldiers 'civilizing and Christianizing' Filipinos at $13 a month as commercial conquest.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Said the capitalist system was doomed and breaking down under its own forces.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: Held that wage-workers in the American mills, mines and railroads are exploited by the capitalist class, producing wealth that others take.

elective-rulers.rationale: Condemned hereditary autocracy and called for democratic rule by the people.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Urged people to join the Socialist Party and said one cannot do one's duty by proxy.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Said the press and pulpit serve the ruling class, with the press calling for war and the pulpit adding its Amen.

party-own-road.rationale: Wrote that each nation's workers must adapt their methods to their own conditions and that the Russian way may not be the American way.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Wrote that John Brown's blow against chattel slavery broke the storm that ended it and that the Confederacy was lashed to fury by emancipation.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Said a standing army is the main difference between despotism and democracy and a general might seize power.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Denounced landlords as 'lords of the land' who keep half the tillable soil idle and pocket unearned increment, and demanded the earth for all the people.

corporate-influence.rationale: Charged that corporations and trusts dictate judicial appointments and that Wall Street owns both major parties.

job-guarantee.rationale: Asked why a state that can employ prisoners cannot give people steady work before they are driven to crime.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Said there are times when it is treasonable to be law-abiding and called for the party to stand by revolutionary principle even when charged with treason.

industrial-unions.rationale: Told workers to organize by industry, not by craft, and helped found the Industrial Workers of the World.

informal-organisation.rationale: Built permanent unions and a mass political party and urged workers to join both.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Described a miner under common ownership building himself a comfortable home to live in with his family.

defeat-communism.rationale: Declared himself a Bolshevik from head to foot and urged moral, spiritual and financial support for the Soviet government.

religion-illusion.rationale: Said it was slander to claim socialism aimed to destroy religion and argued real religion would come only once the struggle for existence ended.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Described the new order as developing inside the old and the trusts as transforming industry before the people take it over.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Said the Socialist Party is pledged to strike the fetters of economic and political slavery from womanhood and tied women's low wages to the system.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Championed socialism and the Soviet revolution as the road ahead rather than a middle course.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Argued that suppressing the Socialist press and imprisoning speakers was a mark of plutocratic despotism.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Described a party run from the bottom up and industrial democracy in which workers manage their own shops.

alienated-labor.rationale: Said capitalism reduces human labour to a commodity and workers are industrial slaves who do not control their jobs or products.

social-market-economy.rationale: Rejected reform of capitalism by regulation and demanded social ownership of the nation's industries.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Showed contempt for kaisers and hereditary rule and predicted the monarchy in Russia would fall.

property-franchise.rationale: Demanded the complete enfranchisement of women and equal rights regardless of race, colour, creed or nationality.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Said the capitalist press and pulpit serve capital while Socialist papers are suppressed, and called for a working-class press.

racial-franchise.rationale: Wrote that if Black Americans were to be disfranchised for corrupt elections, white men should be stripped of the ballot too, rejecting the aim of Dixon's film.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Said a few owning the sources of life will corrupt politics and enslave workers.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Said it was false and slanderous to charge that socialism aims to destroy religion.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Declared faith in absolute equality between the sexes and said he was no greater than his mother.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Attacked a system where a man who does nothing useful amasses hundreds of millions while workers get barely enough to live on, and wanted miners paid the equivalent of their product.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Described the goal as industrial democracy with the working class holding the public power and managing industry.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Held that all things jointly needed and used ought to be jointly owned.

municipal-property.rationale: Wanted industries to be owned by the nation and democratically administered, not held by localities.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Said the class struggle is colourless and the party will not be divided by any appeal to race prejudice.

racial-pride.rationale: Mocked the pretensions of white superiority while saying Black workers must depend on themselves.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Held that wars waged by master classes for conquest were criminal and that people would readily defend their own country.

arms-reduction.rationale: Urged reducing the army to its former peace footing and saw a disarmament program as suggested by the war, though doubting it would hold under capitalism.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Cited the Bolsheviks' exposure of the Allies' secret treaties as proof of the war's conquest aims.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Urged workers to stop being slaughtered for their masters and was convicted for his anti-war speech.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Backed unions that bargain to improve wages and conditions under the wage system, while aiming ultimately to end that system.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Said that once the party controls the machinery of government it should use it to transfer industries to the workers.

workers-own-party.rationale: Insisted that working people need a party of their own, independent of the Republican and Democratic parties, and later backed a labour party.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Denounced laws that give women no property rights while counting them as property.

women-suffrage.rationale: Wrote that he was never opposed to equal suffrage of the sexes and later demanded complete enfranchisement of women.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Called the immaculate conception a beautiful myth and said the gospel accounts conflict and were distorted by priests.

defend-planned-state.rationale: Urged giving the Soviet government every possible support, though he did not address defending it under bureaucratic rule.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: Proposed that the people of each province in dispute should decide by popular vote which nation they join or whether to stay independent.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: Inferred: he opposed capital punishment even after trial and condemned mob lynching as bloodlust.

resources-common-ownership.rationale: Demanded the earth for all the people and attacked landlords for pocketing unearned value created by the community.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: Built and led parties and unions as the means for working people to act politically and economically.

automate-paid-work.rationale: Proposed shortening the working day in proportion to the development of productive machinery.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: Said workers produce all wealth and that the capitalist takes what they produce beyond a bare living, and wanted miners to receive the value of their product.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Mocked 'patriotism' of the ruling class and held workers' loyalty is to their class, yet said he was always a patriotic Socialist and wanted to build a free nation of the people.

material-over-identity.rationale: Insisted the Negro question is part of the labour question and that the class struggle is colourless, but also backed women's and racial equality as party principles.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: Said private ownership and competition had had their day and wanted production for use instead.

notes: He moved from craft unionism (Brotherhood of Locomotive Firemen) to industrial unionism and socialism after the 1894 Pullman strike. His anti-immigration-restriction and race-equality stances are from 1903-1910. His praise for Bolshevism (1918-1919) was tempered in 1922 by insisting each country find its own road. Wording on direct action and violence is mixed: he backed political revolution and praised John Brown but rejected anarchist direct action. Inferred answers are marked low.
